# React Bits (vendored)

Components copied from [React Bits](https://reactbits.dev) by David Haz, TypeScript + CSS variants,
fetched from `https://reactbits.dev/r/<Name>-TS-CSS.json` on 2026-11-22. Licence: MIT + Commons Clause
(https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/LICENSE.md): we may ship them in this site but may not
sell or redistribute the components themselves.

Kept as upstream wrote them, so lint and formatting skip this folder. To update one, fetch it again from
the registry and re-run the site checks. Every component used here honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
